summary: Created a 5-phase plan promoting three of the four scratch witness probes into CslibTests/ as #guard_msgs-asserted, CI-protected files (WitnessProbe, WitnessSearch3, MinProbe), with MinProbe's doc-comment-before-#eval! parse error fixed by construction. WitnessSearch2's exhaustive powerset enumeration is deliberately not ported as a live computation; its CI-relevant content folds into WitnessProbe as specific-witness assertions plus attributed prose. Final phase runs mk_all barrel registration and the full CSLib CI order.
decisions_made: Three promoted files, not four: WitnessSearch2.lean gets no CslibTests/ counterpart because a file of that name containing no search would misrepresent itself; its content folds into CslibTests/WitnessProbe.lean.
Base names kept (WitnessProbe, WitnessSearch3, MinProbe) to minimise the diff at the later Scheme.lean citation-update follow-up.
MinProbe's parse error is fixed by converting the two offending /-- ... -/ blocks into #guard_msgs arguments, which removes the docstring-attachment problem rather than working around it.
A reconciliation protocol distinguishes formatting differences (transcribe the actual string) from semantic differences (escalate as a finding, mark phase BLOCKED, never adjust the assertion).
Research report correction applied: MinProbe.lean does NOT import Minimal.Soundness; WitnessSearch3.lean does, and that import is tested for removal in Phase 2.
Phase 4's cheap inclPairs assertion is bounded by a measured ~10s budget with a documented prose-only fallback.
dead_ends: Porting WitnessSearch2.lean's subsets/searchWitness full enumeration into CI: research measured no output after 9m10s, not even for the first formula. Do not retry as a live build-time computation.
